svg.title: Launching and completing a cell-measurement task
svg.desc: Python saves the selected image, cells and measurement choices, then starts QuPath through the operating system. Within the QuPath task, a DAPI image window and a cell mask produce the mean of three schematic intensities, 2, 4 and 6. The stage saves a Parquet measurement table and a result record. Python reads those files and the process outcome before recording completion. The same cell c1 and mean 4 are retained throughout.
